# Glucose Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened related to Glucose.

## Scope note

Narrower than HealthEvent (and DiabetesEvent); a single blood-glucose reading synced via the health-tracking pipeline.

## Broader

- [Diabetes Event](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
